faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for ERNET India Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the ERNET India recruitment is 07 September 2026. Ensure your application reaches before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in ERNET India Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: ERNET India has announced a total of 6 vacancies for various Project Engineer and Project Manager positions. These include Project Engineer Level 02, Senior Project Engineer, Project Manager Level 01, and Project Manager Level 02.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for these posts?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a full-time B. Tech./BE/MCA/M. Sc. or an equivalent degree in relevant disciplines such as Electronics, Information Technology, Computer Science, and others as specified in the notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary range for the recruited candidates?
faq.answer: The salary for the positions ranges from Rs. 35,000/- to Rs. 1,25,000/- per month, depending on the post and level of appointment.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application process for ERNET India Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Interested candidates need to apply via email. This involves preparing a detailed bio-data, attaching necessary documents, and sending the application to the official email address before the last date.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for ERNET India Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for these positions?
faq.answer: The selection process for the advertised posts will primarily be based on an interview. Candidates shortlisted after the initial screening will be called for the interview.

faq.question: Q8. Are there any age relaxations available for reserved categories?
faq.answer: Yes, age relaxation will be provided to SC/ST/OBC/EWS candidates as per the Government of India norms. Specific age limits are not mentioned for general candidates.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification for ERNET India Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be accessed through the 'Important Links' section of this article. It is highly recommended to read the notification thoroughly before applying.

faq.question: Q10. What is the job type for these positions?
faq.answer: The positions are offered on a contract basis. This means the employment will be for a fixed tenure as per the terms and conditions outlined in the contract.
